templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: The URL to the API. Typically, this will be https://api.nmbrsapp.com/api

templateOptions.label: Token URL
templateOptions.description: The URL to obtain the API token. Typically, this will be https://identityservice.nmbrs.com/connect/token

templateOptions.label: Token Host DNS Name
templateOptions.description: The DNS name of the host to obtain the API token. Typically, this will be identityservice.nmbrs.com

templateOptions.label: Client ID
templateOptions.description: The client ID of the app definition in the Nmbrs partner portal

templateOptions.label: Client secret
templateOptions.description: The client secret of the app definition in the Nmbrs partner portal

templateOptions.label: Subscription Key
templateOptions.description: The subscription key (Primary Key) of the Nmbrs API subscription

templateOptions.label: Initial RefreshToken
templateOptions.description: The initial refresh token, generated with GetRefreshTokenFromAuthorisationCode.ps1. Used when the token file does not exist yet or contains an invalid token.

templateOptions.label: Refresh Token Save File
templateOptions.description: Full path of the file on the HelloID agent server where the (encrypted) tokens are saved, e.g. C:\HelloID\Nmbrs\target_token.json. Do not use the same file as the Nmbrs source connector.

templateOptions.label: Proxy address
templateOptions.description: The address of the proxy, e.g. http://proxy.domain.local:8080

templateOptions.label: Toggle debug logging
templateOptions.description: When toggled, debug logging will be displayed
